bound.how: pda ingest --source locationforecast --limit 10. The official MET Locationforecast swagger prints 5 untemplated GET paths that have a last-segment id and no required query parameter. The adapter copies those paths. GET uses the printed /locations collection with no invented query filters. Forecast paths print required lat/lon so they stay unused for listing and fetch.
